effect.name: Motion Extraction
effect.description: reveals motion by comparing the current frame with a delayed copy of the stream
effect.author: phoebus-84

parameter.name: Time Offset
parameter.comment:
Time offset in seconds (0-2).
Limited to 128 frames / 1 GiB of history; 0 = previous frame

parameter.name: Blend
parameter.comment:
Opacity of the inverted delayed
frame in negative overlay mode

parameter.name: Monochrome
parameter.comment:
Compare luminance only and
produce a grayscale result

parameter.name: Threshold
parameter.comment:
Ignore differences smaller than
this to suppress noise
